scope: The principal Nan Hua Temple shrine at Bronkhorstspruit as documented in March 2006. Includes the main two-tier hall, raised podium and stairs, and short roofed connections within the mapped main-shrine footprint. The enclosing precinct, separate main gate, guesthouse and shrine interior are outside the scope.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The temple history documents the Fo Guang Shan development in Bronkhorstspruit, locally made cast concrete balcony rails, and the separate guesthouse and other buildings.
The Fo Guang Shan founder lists the South African temple opening in 2005.
